summary.zh-Hant: 樞密院司法委員會裁決拉布拉多邊界：爭議地區幾乎全歸紐芬蘭
summary.en: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council decides the Labrador boundary, awarding practically the whole disputed territory to Newfoundland

citations.locator: p. 1036, Appendix, 3. The Labrador Boundary Award
citations.evidenceNote: 「The long-standing controversy between the Dominion of Canada and Newfoundland with regard to their boundary in the Labrador Peninsula was, by consent of both parties, referred to the Judicial Committee of the British, Privy Council for decision. On March 1, 1927, this decision, awarding practically the whole territory in dispute to Newfoundland, was announced.」
citations.gradeBasis: 加拿大官方年鑑記載裁決結果（對加拿大不利的一方自己的官方記載）。裁決本文尚未取得。

timeNote.zh-Hant: 裁決 1927-03-01 宣布。資料庫裡加拿大、紐芬蘭的疆界紀錄照資料集在 1927-03-11 換段，和裁決日差十天，原因還沒查，所以這個事件沒有接成那些紀錄的起訖事件。
timeNote.en: Decision announced 1 March 1927. The border records switch on 1927-03-11 (dataset date); the ten-day difference is unexplained, so this event is not linked as their start or end event.
